en_title: Skate Studio Also Hit With Cuts as Scope of EA's Mass Layoffs Becomes Clearer
subtitle: 又一轮裁员
opus_summary: EA裁员波及《Skate》开发商Full Circle，多名员工确认离职，具体人数尚未公布。EA表示将缩减团队规模，继续推进服务型滑板游戏；彭博社称此次裁员约400人，占员工总数3%。

paragraphs.en: Following the announcement that EA is closing down Mass Effect developer BioWare, staff at the studio behind the latest Skate game have also reported suffering layoffs.
paragraphs.cn: EA宣布关闭《质量效应》开发商BioWare后，最新《极速滑板》游戏开发团队的员工也陆续确认遭到裁员。

paragraphs.en: The live-service skating game was briefly mentioned as an ongoing active project in the memo EA sent to staff about the dramatic cuts, but an undetermined number of Skate developers said they had been let go from the studio behind it, Full Circle.
paragraphs.cn: EA发给员工的裁员备忘录曾短暂提到，这款服务型滑板游戏仍是正在开发的项目。不过，负责开发该作的工作室Full Circle已有数量不明的《极速滑板》开发者表示，他们已经被解雇。

paragraphs.en: Seasonal creative director, John Epler, wrote on LinkedIn (via VGC ): “Well, as of today, my role at Full Circle has been eliminated. Coming up on my 19 year anniversary in the industry — and all of that time spent at EA — I can’t say I’m sad. A little nervous, definitely, but I’m looking forward to doing something new.”
paragraphs.cn: 赛季创意总监John Epler在LinkedIn上发文表示：「好了，从今天起，我在Full Circle的职位已经被裁撤。我在这个行业工作快满19年了，而且这段时间全部都在EA度过。我不能说自己很难过，确实有一点紧张，但我很期待接下来尝试新事物。」

paragraphs.en: Senior game designer Adam Martinazzi also confirmed his departure. “I, like many of the other talented people at Full Circle, was let go today,” he said. “Part of me is sad and frustrated. The other part accepts that this is a ‘just part of the industry.' And the other other part is grateful for the time I got to spend working on a cool game with lots of awesome people.”
paragraphs.cn: 高级游戏设计师Adam Martinazzi也确认自己已经离职。他说：「和Full Circle的许多其他优秀员工一样，我今天也被解雇了。一部分的我感到难过和沮丧，另一部分则接受了这只是‘行业的一部分’。还有另一部分的我很感激，自己曾有机会和这么多出色的人一起开发一款很酷的游戏。」

paragraphs.en: Another senior designer, David Milne, was among those affected. “Looks like my position at Full Circle has been eliminated. Sad to have to leave. I really enjoyed working on Skate and loved the team I worked with. But it’s on to the next thing now.”
paragraphs.cn: 另一名高级设计师David Milne也受到影响。他说：「看来我在Full Circle的职位已经被裁撤了。不得不离开让我很难过。我真的很享受开发《极速滑板》的过程，也很喜欢曾共事的团队。不过，现在该继续面对下一件事了。」

paragraphs.en: Full Circle was previously hit by a wave of layoffs back in February. “The teammates affected are talented colleagues and friends who helped build the foundation of Skate,” Full Circle said at the time. “Their creativity and dedication are deeply ingrained in what players experience today. This decision is not a reflection of their impact and we’re committed to supporting them through this transition.”
paragraphs.cn: 今年2月，Full Circle此前也曾遭遇一轮裁员。当时Full Circle表示：「受到影响的队友都是帮助奠定《极速滑板》基础的优秀同事和朋友。他们的创造力与投入，已经深深融入玩家如今体验到的游戏之中。这项决定并不代表他们所作出的贡献，我们会在这段过渡期继续为他们提供支持。」

paragraphs.en: EA's memo to staff had this to say about Skate:
paragraphs.cn: EA发给员工的备忘录这样介绍《极速滑板》：

paragraphs.en: "For skate., we’ve had a lot of success in bringing players into the game, and we need to create an experience that keeps them engaged over the long-term. To do that, we are making changes to the studio to have a more focused, smaller team to deliver on a very clear roadmap for our community that we believe will build a healthier and more sustainable business."
paragraphs.cn: 「在《极速滑板》方面，我们成功吸引了大量玩家加入游戏。接下来，我们需要打造一种能够长期维持玩家参与度的体验。为此，我们将调整工作室，组建一支规模更小、目标更集中的团队，按照清晰的路线图为社区持续提供内容。我们相信，这将帮助公司建立更健康、更可持续的业务。」

paragraphs.en: According to Bloomberg , 400 jobs are going across EA, amounting to 3% of total staff. 50 of these were working on the next Mass Effect before BioWare's closure. Just two weeks ago, Full Circle published a statement addressing mods following the viral launch of a fan-made modding platform called ReSkate . This platform allows fans to play the game offline, create private servers, make their own maps, and more. Full Circle acknowledged the importance of community mods, but stood firm against those that bypass paid cosmetics or make money off of new features.
paragraphs.cn: 据彭博社报道，EA此次将裁撤400个岗位，约占员工总数的3%。在BioWare关闭前，其中50人曾参与下一部《质量效应》的开发。就在两周前，粉丝自制模组平台Re极速滑板走红后，Full Circle曾发布声明回应模组问题。该平台允许玩家离线游玩、创建私人服务器、制作自己的地图等。Full Circle承认社区模组的重要性，但仍坚决反对绕过付费外观内容，或利用新功能牟利的模组。

paragraphs.en: Full Circle went on to confirm that it was aware that players want “more freedom and custom features,” and revealed that it was building “official, secure access tools that enable broader, deeper community creation.”
paragraphs.cn: Full Circle随后确认，他们知道玩家希望获得「更多自由和自定义功能」，并透露正在开发「官方且安全的访问工具，让社区能够进行更广泛、更深入的创作」。

paragraphs.en: EA went private earlier this year with Saudi Arabian involvement . "This moment recognizes the extraordinary people whose creativity, ambition and passion have made EA one of the world's leading interactive entertainment companies," CEO Andrew Wilson, who pocketed a compensation package of $38.6 million for the 2026 fiscal year, said at the time. Wilson had Battlefield 6 to thank for strong performance for the fiscal year, but a record-breaking launch didn’t stop EA from laying off staff across Battlefield Studios .
paragraphs.cn: 今年早些时候，在沙特方面参与下，EA完成私有化。时任CEO Andrew Wilson表示：「这一刻肯定了那些非凡的人，是他们的创造力、雄心与热情，让EA成为全球领先的互动娱乐公司之一。」Wilson在2026财年获得了3,860万美元(约合人民币3亿元)的薪酬待遇。该财年的强劲表现要归功于《战地风云6》，但即便该作创下破纪录的首发成绩，也没能阻止EA在《战地风云》系列各工作室裁员。
